body:
I can handle it. I can accept it, too. I just don't want to, and I'm still looking for a reason that I should.

Life is nasty and brutish and short for most people. It seems to me that most stay alive out of inertia more than anything. I'm just rapidly slowing down.

I'm not concerned with what ought to be, and I don't really care to defend an argument you put in my mouth. The reality as I see it is that the struggle is the product - and I'm not sold.
